text:
Lena (CEO): Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands earlier. Opening this thread for rapid follow-ups on mission/positioning/competitors. Keep Qs short and well try to answer today.

Sana (Product): Quick: does 'developer-first' mean we prioritize SDKs and docs over dashboard features?

Rafael (CTO): Developer-first means SDKs/docs and API parity come first, but Console is product-critical for enterprise workflows. We prioritize where it impacts time-to-prod.

Tom (Eng): For private deployments, what's the expected lag after Hosted for new runtime features (like KV cache improvements)?

Rafael (CTO): Typically 6-12 weeks due to packaging and compatibility testing; hotfixes can be faster. We'll add a changelog tag for 'Private-ready' when we cut release candidates.

Nima (Sales): Messaging ask: how do we talk about "inferencing economics" to buyers who only care about list price per token?

Lena (CEO): Frame it around predictable costs and unit economics: not just price/token but cost/token under real load (batching, cache hit rate). Use customer examples showing 2-4x savings vs naive run.

Kai (Research): Competitor question: are we planning to release microbenchmarks comparing latency/cost across common models?

Rafael (CTO): Yes, but anonymized and reproducible benchmarks. We'll publish a methodology doc so buyers trust the numbers.

Tom (Eng): Regarding SLAs: any guidance on what we can commit in contracts for Dedicated vs Hosted? specific numbers would help legal/sales.

Rafael (CTO): Dedicated: target 99.9% for committed pools; Hosted: best-effort SLA for free tier, 99.5% for paid tiers. Latency SLOs vary by instance class. Legal to draft standard contract language.

infra-bot: Deployment notice: rolling runtime upgrade tonight 02:00 UTC. Expected <5min service blip for a subset of regions.

Sana (Product): Follow-up from docs: can we get a one-paragraph positioning summary for press? Sales needs a 2-line elevator pitch too.

Lena (CEO): I'll send a press-friendly blurb in this thread within 24 hours.

Nima (Sales): Can we also get a one-pager that contrasts us with "general cloud AI" vs "LLM API providers"? Helps field calls.

Kai (Research): Final q: what reliability metrics will marketing publish besides uptime? error-budget consumption? fallback rate?

Lena (CEO): Publish uptime, percent requests served within latency SLO, and fallback invocation rate. We'll ensure data is framed with context.

Sana (Product): Ok tagging @Rafael @Lena @Nima  I'll collect artifacts and post here.

Lena (CEO): Thanks team, will update when the PRs/docs are ready. :rocket:
